intent: Endless vertical columns of testimonial cards drifting at different speeds, masked top and bottom. Hovering or focusing a column eases it to a stop; the card under the pointer lifts with a spotlight border.

stack.animation: requestAnimationFrame per column writing transforms directly; motion/react for the entrance and useReducedMotion

layout.root: @container section, fixed height 720px (one column caps at 600px)
layout.columns: ResizeObserver on root: 3 from 900px, 2 from 560px, else 1; testimonials dealt round-robin; gap 16px (20px @3xl)
layout.viewport: overflow hidden; mask linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, #000 18%, #000 82%, transparent)
layout.track: three copies of the set (clone, real, clone); one set height including trailing gap = period P; repeat items if P < viewport height
layout.card: figure, radius 16px, padding 20px (24px @3xl); quote then caption row with 36px avatar
layout.pause: 32px round button with a 44px hit area, bottom-right

typography.quote: 15px, leading 1.6, tracking -0.005em, white/55, text-wrap pretty; **phrase** at white/90
typography.name: 14px, weight 500, tracking -0.01em, white/90

color.card: #0c0c0d, inset 1px white/7%, top highlight white/5%; hover #111113
color.spotlight: surface radial 320px at 5.5% white; border radial 180px at 42% white via mask-composite exclude
color.avatar: radial hsl(h 32% 26%) to hsl(h 30% 12%), text hsl(h 70% 84%), ring hsl(h 50% 70% / .18); h hashed from name
color.pause: #141416 with inset white/10 ring, icon white/60 to white

motion.drift: per-column speeds 24, 30, 20 px/s; odd columns down, even up; phase offset P * ((i*0.37 + 0.11) mod 1)
motion.velocityEasing: v += (goal - v) * (1 - exp(-dt / tau)); tau 0.32s when stopping (hover/focus/paused), 0.7s when resuming
motion.wrap: y modulo P; seamless because copies are identical
motion.focusGlide: focused card moves fully into view, margin max(56px, 15% height), exponential follow tau 0.11s
motion.cardHover: lift 3px, surface #111113, deep shadow, spotlight fades in; 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)
motion.entrance: once at 20% in view: columns rise 16px and fade in, 700ms ease-out, 70ms stagger
motion.offscreen: loops stop when out of view or the tab is hidden
motion.reducedMotion: static grid at natural height: no masks, clones, drift or lift

responsive.units: container queries (@3xl) for gaps and card padding

accessibility: cards are focusable figures with blockquote + figcaption; focus stops the column and brings the card into view
scrollTop reset so focus never scrolls the clipped column
clones aria-hidden and inert; repeated items tabindex -1
pause/play button with aria-pressed and a descriptive label

content.testimonials: 12 specific quotes, e.g. 'Our p95 build went from 9m 40s to 2m 12s. I checked twice because I assumed the cache was lying.' — Dana Okafor, Platform Lead, Fernway

avoid: CSS keyframe marquees with animation-play-state (they stop dead)
more than one highlighted phrase per quote
a headline or section chrome around the wall
